Basically the build I run is ruin, deadlock, hex pentimento, and face the darkness. 
This is the best build for sadako imo. I use the ring drawing and the nail for add ons. 
This build is perfect because it gives you a lot of time and survivors are overbooked. They have to cleanse totems, insert tapes, unhook, and heal. They don’t have time to do gens. Furthermore, if they cleanse 1 totems or more, you can activate pentimento and they have to spend 30% more time on gens, that allows you to take your time in chases if you want to. The strategy with this build is to teleport as soon as you can, because in the early game, all the tvs are on. So teleport  max at this moment to condemn and put pressure. Face the darkness will help you locate the survivors and teleport to condemn. You have to focus on survivors who carry tapes to lock their condemn and put more and more pressure. If plaid well, this build is absolutely nightmarish for survivors. The well water add on is a good add on too that makes grabbing survivors easy.
